text:
alex.sales: Hoist wants a 2-week POC to migrate from CompetitorX. Key asks: prompt parity, response diffs, token billing impact, security Q. Can we scope?

maria.se: Quick smoke showed two issues: streaming chunk sizes differ (breaks their UI) and CompetitorX tokenizes some prompts as fewer tokens.

jordan.pdm: POC scope proposal: (1) proxy shim to map endpoints + re-chunk streams, (2) run 10 canonical prompts through both tokenizers and models, (3) small eval harness to quantify semantic drift, (4) billing delta calc.

sam.security: I'll draft the security answers. Flags: they require SAML SSO, audit logs for inputs, and customer KMS for Dedicated. If they need VPC/KMS, timeline extends.

hoist_cto: Confirm SOC2 + HIPAA required. We can share sample prompts today. Prefer server-side shim rather than client changes.

maria.se: I can stand up a proxy and add a re-chunk toggle. Will post token-count diffs and streaming logs by EOD.

alex.sales: I'll draft SOW with three pricing scenarios (no-delta / +10% tokens / +25% tokens) and include mitigation options (prefix caching, lower-cost fallback models). Meeting Friday 11am to review.

hoist_cto: Friday 11am good. Thanks.
